about.title: About RKS Property Hub
about.storyText: RKS Property Hub has surveyed and developed over 500 acres of premium residential land across Tamil Nadu and the Bangalore Corridor since 2010. We specialize in identifying high-growth corridors and transforming them into secure, clear-titled communities for generations to build upon.
about.transparencyDesc: Zero hidden costs, verified legal documents, and transparent fixed per-sqft pricing.
about.clearTitlesDesc: Every land parcel goes through multi-tier legal checks before offering to buyers.
about.communityFirstDesc: Thoughtfully planned layouts with wide internal roads, avenue trees, and underground utilities.
about.growthCorridorsDesc: Positioned near upcoming expressways, defense corridors, and IT hubs for compounding appreciation.

legal.title: Legal Information & Disclaimers
